note: Hand fixes for 8271 Creekbend Dr Unit 8271 (condo, interior only). Coordinates are Matterport plan coordinates (x, y), not house-local.

splits.why: Matterport classifies the whole 46 m2 open area as 'Kitchen'. The galley kitchen and the dining corner (chandelier, mirror wall) are west of the peninsula counter, whose living-room face is at x = -5.80 (near-orthographic top view of v50); the living room with the fireplace is east of it. The line sits on that face so the peninsula is measured as a fixture from the kitchen side.
West of the peninsula: the galley (west counter, stove, fridge, peninsula) ends at y = -1.06, where the west counter's end panel and the peninsula's end are; south of it is the dining corner.
